answer: No. Because your brother is on active military deployment, he can sign the deployed owner authorization, form NW-MIL-1, instead of a notarized power of attorney, and it is accepted in Georgia. He can sign it electronically and attach a copy of his deployment orders. Other powers of attorney in Georgia, including NW-POA-2, would still need to be notarized, and whoever brings the car needs their own photo ID.
